advancements.orespawn_integrations.world: Rites call the kings by name, industry rolls the metals, and the statues never forget. The rest of the pack finally admits OreSpawn happened.
Chalk the circle, lay out the scales, and wait for a real thunderstorm. Gojira does not answer clear skies.
Finish the full catalyst grind and raise a statue of Mobzilla. The boss finally holds still.
The Philosopher's Stone has learned some local geology — stone, soil, and timber can all wear Crystal Dimension colors now. Redecorate responsibly. Or don't.
Roll OreSpawn titanium into reinforced rail. Industry has acknowledged the ores. The ores are flattered.
Craft an aircraft with your own two hands. The recipes were in the files all along — somebody finally plugged them in.
